messages:
maria: rolling out 'twin-cache' (edge prefetch + local LRU) for host-llama-small to prod now. Benchmarks look good: gen workloads p50 -18%, p95 -7%, unit_cost -22% on tokens. Canary was 10% of traffic for 4h. Details below. cc @ryan @devon :rocket:

deploy-bot: rollout start: twin-cache v1 -> prod (hosts: 8) id=rb-211223

devon: nice. what's the eviction policy? any regressions on long-context chat sessions?

maria: eviction=LRU(1MB per shard), hot-prefetch window=8 tokens, async prefetch on request start. no regressions on 32k-token sims in canary. sample config:
```
{"cache_mode":"twin","edge_prefetch_ms":15,"local_cap_mb":1024,"evict":"lru"}
```

ryan: can you drop the dashboard query? want to share with infra leads.

maria: dashboard: https://redwood.internal/d/abc123/twin-cache?orgId=1
query snippet:
```
avg_over_time(latency_p50{model="host-llama-small"}[1h])
```
Canary -> prod summary: p50 210ms -> 172ms (-18%), p95 620ms -> 577ms (-7%), CPU/GPU utl ~flat, observed 22% lower server-token-cost due to extra local hits.

erin: any impact for Dedicated customers? should we include this in release notes?

maria: Dedicated gets same runtime but prefetch disabled by default for pinned infra; we enabled LRU only for dedicated canaries. We'll add to release notes and cherrypick config to dedicated package next week.

deploy-bot: rollout complete: twin-cache v1 -> prod 100% success. id=rb-211223 status=ok :white_check_mark:

devon: awesome. can we schedule a short postmortem in eng-runtime next week to review perf probes and failure modes? also, run a quick sim for tail-heavy dialog.

maria: 1: yes. 2: already queued a 24h tail sim job (job id: sim-211223-twincache) :thumbsup:

sara: n1ce work team :clap:

maria: thanks everyone — we'll monitor dashboards and open a follow-up thread if anything pops up.
